claims.statement: The Carmelite Fra Pietro da Novellara tells Isabella d'Este that Leonardo is working on a small Madonna with a yarnwinder and has made little progress with the St Anne cartoon.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Letter of Fra Pietro da Novellara, 3 April 1501.
